Project Zymera · Zero-Shot Generalization

Zero-shot versatility, by map type

Only the layouts each policy never trained on — organized by the kind of obstacle world.

Pure inference · 24×24 · 6 agents · comm-range 5 · 100 steps · two policies of identical architecture — one trained on open floor, one on 3-room corridors. In-distribution rollouts are hidden; every tile below is a world its policy did not see in training.

HeadlineOn the map types that are zero-shot for both policies (random clutter, pillar lattices, room+clutter composites), the rooms-trained policy averages 37% coverage vs the open-trained policy's 25% — training on one obstacle style transfers to obstacle styles it never saw; the open-floor specialist does not.
